Department of Biotechnology (DBT), Ministry of Science & Technology, Government of India
3 years or until completion of the project
Upper age limit 40 years for male candidates and 45 years for female candidates, as on the last date of application

content_sections.heading: About JMI Research Associate
content_sections.text: Jamia Millia Islamia is a Central University in New Delhi. This post is in a DBT-funded research project at its Department of Environmental Science, under the Faculty of Engineering & Technology. The project studies epigenetic and transcriptomic alterations induced by urban air pollutants in human airway epithelial cells, and Prof. Rajeev Singh is the Principal Investigator.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: PhD degree in Life Sciences/Biotechnology/Zoology/Biosciences/Environmental Sciences or any field of Life Sciences. Hands-on experience in: mammalian cell culture and air–liquid interface (ALI) culture; DNA/RNA isolation, PCR/qRT-PCR and ELISA/Western blotting; oxidative-stress assays; epigenetic assays (including DNA methylation/ChIP-based methods); transcriptomic or bioinformatics analysis; experimental design, data analysis and scientific writing. The upper age limit is 40 years for male candidates and 45 years for female candidates, as on the last date of application. Age relaxation, wherever applicable, will be governed by the rules of the funding agency/Government of India/University. Check the official notification for the full eligibility of the Research Associate post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The Research Associate gets ₹58,000 per month plus 27% HRA, which the notice totals as ₹73,660 per month. The project duration is 3 years or until completion of the project. The appointment is purely temporary and may be terminated with one month's notice from either side, without assigning any reason, subject to the applicable project/University rules. The position is co-terminus with the project; the selected candidate shall have no claim for regular appointment or for continuation/absorption in any other project or post at Jamia Millia Islamia. The guidelines of the funding agency and the applicable rules/norms of Jamia Millia Islamia will govern the recruitment and appointment.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for JMI Research Associate
content_sections.text: Fill in the application form printed on page 3 of the notice: post applied for, name, father's name, date of birth, category, address, mobile number, e-mail, photo, educational qualifications, experience, description of research projects handled, technical expertise, date, place and signature. Prepare a cover letter, the application form, your CV and supporting documents. Combine all of them into a single PDF file. Submit the PDF through the Google Form link given in the notice: https://forms.gle/Ye4mSCixRJM3V7Af8 Also send it by email to [email protected] . Complete the submission on or before 4 December 2026. Applications are accepted only through this mode and in the prescribed format. Incomplete applications or applications without the required supporting documents will not be accepted. Cover letter Application form (in the format on page 3) CV Supporting documents Original certificates/documents, to be presented at the interview for verification

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Only shortlisted candidates will be communicated/called to appear for the interview. Original certificates/documents must be presented at the time of interview for verification. No TA/DA or any other allowance will be reimbursed/paid to candidates for attending the interview. The interview date and venue are not specified in the notice.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Misrepresentation, suppression of facts, or canvassing in any form shall lead to disqualification and may lead to termination if detected after appointment. No interim enquiries regarding the selection process will be entertained. The competent authority reserves the right to cancel, postpone, or modify the recruitment process without assigning any reason.

faq.question: Q1. How many Research Associate vacancies are there at JMI?
faq.answer: There is 01 Research Associate post in the DBT-funded project at the Department of Environmental Science, Jamia Millia Islamia.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the JMI Research Associate post?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted on or before 4 December 2026, through the Google Form and by email to [email protected].

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is required for the JMI Research Associate post?
faq.answer: A PhD degree in Life Sciences/Biotechnology/Zoology/Biosciences/Environmental Sciences or any field of Life Sciences is essential. Hands-on experience in cell culture, molecular, epigenetic and transcriptomic methods is desirable.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the JMI Research Associate post?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 40 years for male candidates and 45 years for female candidates, as on the last date of application. Age relaxation, wherever applicable, follows the rules of the funding agency/Government of India/University.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of the JMI Research Associate?
faq.answer: The salary is ₹58,000 + 27% HRA per month, which comes to ₹73,660 per month as printed in the notice.

faq.question: Q6. Is HRA paid on top of the JMI Research Associate salary?
faq.answer: Yes. The notice gives 27% HRA on top of ₹58,000 per month, totalling ₹73,660 per month.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for the JMI Research Associate post?
faq.answer: Combine the cover letter, application form, CV and supporting documents into a single PDF file and submit it through the Google Form and by email to [email protected] on or before 4 December 2026.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the JMI Research Associate post?
faq.answer: Only shortlisted candidates will be called for the interview, where original certificates/documents must be presented for verification.

faq.question: Q9. Is the JMI Research Associate a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. The appointment is purely temporary and co-terminus with the project, which lasts 3 years or until completion, and gives no claim to regular appointment at Jamia Millia Islamia.

faq.question: Q10. Will JMI pay TA/DA for attending the interview?
faq.answer: No. No TA/DA or any other allowance will be reimbursed/paid to candidates for attending the interview.
